box: site-owner-wizard §2 arm-check tells the truth in every reachable state
method: Drove the real scripts/site-owner-wizard.sh (not a re-implementation of its logic) once per state, feeding the interactive prompts from stdin. notCovered: secret VALUES — a typo'd GUID still prints ARMED, then fails loud at azure/login@v2
OIDC trust validity — the federated credential can be deleted independently; fails loud
--check mode — maybe_verify returns early when CHECK_MODE=1, so no arm verdict is printed
a gh that exits 0 with a stale or partial list — that set is owned by the GitHub CLI, so enumerating it would never converge
residualDivergenceFromTheRealGate: An empty-valued secret would print ARMED while HAS_DEPLOY_IDENTITY stays false. That is the safe direction. warischa is a User account with no org secrets and ci.yml declares no environment:, so `gh secret list` and secrets.* otherwise enumerate the same set.
harnessNote: The first calibration attempt returned four EMPTY legs and looked like a total failure. Cause was the harness, not the script: macOS has no `timeout`, so the wrapper failed and the wizard never ran. Recorded because the same mistake inside a grep-for-absence check would have read as a clean pass rather than an obvious blank.
